headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO causing shares to surge over 25 percent
label: NEWS
caption:
Nvidia has officially reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer 💻

Nvidia announced on Monday that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as chief executive with immediate effect according to reports by Dawn.

Nvidia shares surged by more than 25 percent in premarket trading following the announcement according to Dawn.

The decision marks a dramatic reversal after the board of directors had ruled out his return just days prior Dawn reported.

Huang built the company from a video game chip maker into the dominant supplier of artificial intelligence processors according to Dawn.

Meanwhile The New York Times reported that Alice Huang was in touch with a Chinese spy agency during an affair with the Nvidia chief executive according to Reuters.
